text:
marina: Heads-up — change window tonight 23:00 UTC. We're planning to unpin runtime 2.14 in region-a. Need clarity on deploybot's pin-swap behavior: will it unpin runtime only or also automatically pin a fallback model variant? I want a deterministic fallback for quantized models. @deploybot any docs?

deploybot: automated: scheduled change-window accepted. Suggested command: `deploybot pin-swap --target runtime:2.14 --action unpin --fallback model:llama3q-quant-v2`. Use `--dry-run` to preview. Docs: https://internal.redwood/deploybot/pin-swap

ashwin: If we only unpin runtime, SDKs that pin model versions may still route to legacy runtime paths and cause mismatches. Recommend runtime unpin + explicit model-fallback pin for a 2h window. We hit a routing mismatch in eu-west last month.

kai: +1. Proposed playbook snippet to add to runbook:
```
1) dry-run: deploybot pin-swap --dry-run --target runtime:2.14
2) canary: apply to 5% region-a instances (canary-weight=5)
3) monitor: latency / error-rate / kvcache-miss / eval-regressions
4) scale fallback capacity if latency climbs
5) full unpin with 30m rollback window if problems
```
I'll add it to the runbook.

sre-jen: Note: quantized models can change token probabilities across runtimes. Gate on eval-set regression <0.5%. Also enable client autoretry for streaming calls (2 retries, backoff 200ms).

marina: Good catches. @ashwin can you prepare the eval snapshot and the short summary for release notes? Plan timeline: dry-run @ 21:30 UTC, canary @ 22:15 UTC, full @ 23:00 UTC. On-call coverage required. Confirm?

ashwin: On it. I'll post eval link + summary in this thread in ~30m. +1 for autoretry.

kai: I'll configure deploybot flags for tonight: `--canary-weight=5 --fallback-duration=2h --gate=eval:pass`. Will post canary config in ops runbook.

deploybot: automated: dry-run ready. Command used: `deploybot pin-swap --target runtime:2.14 --action unpin --fallback model:llama3q-quant-v2 --canary-weight=5 --dry-run`

sre-jen: I'll be on-call for the window. If error rate spikes >1% or eval reg fails, call a rollback: `deploybot revert --reason "runtime-unpin-failure"`.

marina: Thanks all — tagging this as the canonical coordination thread for tonight. I'll update CHANGE_WINDOW doc and add the release_notes: 'Runtime unpin 2.14 with model fallback; canary + eval gating; 2h fallback window; autoretry enabled.' :thumbsup:
